about: What the public repository holds, for public.py: the program, its sources and what builds it. A path ending in / is a folder. 'keep' is copied from the last commit; 'drop' is then taken out of it.

keep.why: the workspace: its members cut down to those kept
the versions of every crate, without those only the others used
the build's own settings (the C runtime built into each program)
line endings
the GNU General Public License, version 3
every project it builds on, without the private blocks
every setting the program has: its name in the settings file, what it does, its values and its default
the engine: the physics, the player, the helper programs, the library and the settings
the app and its screens
our copies of SDL and SDL_ttf's binding, and FFmpeg's headers
the issue forms
installs the tools a build needs
how the libraries are told to keep this PC's folders out of what they record
builds FFmpeg, libserum, libvni, the USB libraries and what libdmdutil loads
builds PinMAME, with our patches
builds libaltsound, with our patches
builds rom2altsound, which makes AltSound packs from a table's ROM
builds libwinevbs, with our patches
builds libdof, with our patches
builds libdmdutil, with our patches
builds libarchive
gathers, checks and packs a release
makes the player's script-object tables from VPX's interface
paints the kickers' pictures
makes the default room picture
makes the app's catalog of every setting
makes the pause menu's fonts

drop.why: a test of our libdof patches against made-up cabinets, run on the development PC
the public README and .gitignore, put at the top instead
the release's own security and privacy scan, run on the development PC: its patterns name the team's own words
